# Innerscape — ResonantOS add-on (local-only agent surface)

The agent surface of Innerscape (the personal growth OS) — the project brief,
the module map, and a bounded reflective planning prompt — served to your
local AI agents as a private loopback service. It contains zero personal data:
no journal entries, no emotional check-ins, no sleep logs. It requests zero
capabilities, persists nothing, and never sends anything anywhere. Your inner
life stays yours.

## Canonical links

- This repo: https://github.com/simongonzalezdc/resonant-innerscape
- Canonical upstream: https://github.com/KyaniteLabs/Innerscape (MIT)

## Key facts

- ResonantOS 2.0.0-alpha add-on; validator: 0 errors / 0 warnings
- License: MIT
- Wraps only the stateless CLI module (brief, modules, plan); the
  data-bearing backend (72 endpoints), mobile app, and MCP stdio loop are not
  vendored and not reachable through this service
- Zero capabilities, zero persistence, zero egress; personal-data scan in CI

Relationship: community gift by Kyanite Labs for ResonantOS — canonical
upstream: https://github.com/KyaniteLabs/Innerscape; this wrapper is
non-canonical; where anything here disagrees with the canonical upstream, the
canonical upstream wins.
